title: Interleaved streaming + tool-call JSONmode sentinel and schema-violation detection tests
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a focused test harness and set of deterministic tests that validate behavior when JSON mode is enabled and the model emits interleaved streaming tokens that contain tool/function call markers, partial JSON payloads, and schema violations. The goal is to assert the runtime's constrained-decoder enforcement, recovery heuristics, and roll-forward fallback paths across a matrix of model splits, token-loss scenarios, and function-calling interruption patterns.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness capable of simulating streaming responses with arbitrary token drops and out-of-order toolcall boundaries

End-to-end tests that detect schema nonconformance and confirm the runtime either recovers to a valid JSON object, issues a deterministic fallback (textual error + retry), or invokes the configured tool-call fallback policy
CI job that gates against regressions and runs representative cases in < 12 minutes on the nightly pipeline
Coverage across at least three model families (causal-small, transformer-medium, mixture-large) and two quantization profiles
Clear runbook entries for observed failure modes and remediation steps for engineers + PMs
test_plan_steps: Design token-level streaming simulator that can inject: truncated JSON braces, extra commas, unexpected string escapes, and spurious toolcall tokens mid-JSON
Implement a harness shim that plugs into existing streaming decoder tests and toggles 'json_mode' + 'allow_tool_calls' flags
Create canonical golden prompts and reference outputs for: clean JSON stream, partial-object-then-toolcall, toolcall-then-resume-object, bracket-mismatch, and escape-sequence corruption
Enumerate failure expectations per case (recoverable -> emit corrected JSON; unrecoverable -> trigger fallback policy X) and encode assertions
Add test matrix variations: token-drop probability (0%, 1%, 5%), batch size distribution, and KV cache warm/cold states
Wire into nightly CI; add a quick smoke gate for PRs touching decoder / streaming glue code
notes: Motivation: Field incidents in Q4 showed downstream parsers crashed when toolcall tokens split JSON arrays across packets. We need deterministic handling to avoid customer-visible 500s.
Trade-offs considered: strict enforcement (fail fast) vs. heuristic recovery (attempt to reassemble). Default recommendation: heuristic recovery with configurable strictness per customer tier.

Related architecture: streaming schema gating, constrained-decoder backoff, and tool-call arbitration layer in the router. The test harness should be extensible to cover routing fallback behavior as well.
Performance: aim to keep per-test runtime low by mocking model runtime where possible and running only a small set of full-model E2E tests nightly for each family.

2026-02-20 - Rohit Singh: Prototype simulator finished (local). Found that when a toolcall token starts inside a string value we need an additional sentinel to avoid mistakenly invoking tool plumbing.

2026-02-27 - QA (Priya Nair): Ran harness against transformer-medium with 1% token-drop; observed two cases where the constrained decoder accepted malformed numeric literals — added a test to assert numeric canonicalization.

2026-03-05 - Rohit Singh: Incorporated KV-cache warm/cold toggle; discovered a race between cache priming and stream resumption that caused inconsistent sequence_ids in telemetry. Filed ENG-143897 to follow up on telemetry sequencing.

test_matrix_description: Matrix axes: model_family (causal-small|transformer-medium|mixture-large), quant_profile (fp16|int8), token_drop_rate (0|0.01|0.05), toolcall_boundary (clean|starts-in-string|interrupts-json), kv_cache_state (cold|warm). Each cell runs 10 deterministic seeds + 3 stochastic perturbations.
runbook_excerpts: Observed: parser raises JSONDecodeError after toolcall interleaves. Triage: check telemetry for sequence_id mismatch, inspect raw token stream in trace bucket, run harness case 'toolcall-then-resume-object' locally.

Mitigation: if unable to reconstruct a valid JSON within two reconciliation attempts, mark request as 'structured-output-failure' and return a structured error object with guidance for client to retry with 'strict_json=false' flag.
Long-term: add a streaming sentinel token emitted by the runtime before tool-call handoff to guarantee a clean boundary (requires protocol bump).
qa_notes: QA will own writing the golden reference corpus and verifying the harness against nightly environment for 3 consecutive runs before we flip the strict CI gate.
Edge-case to validate: partial unicode escapes and multi-byte character splits across token boundaries.
